content: Loyverse models a Shift as: POS/terminal + opening time + closing time + opening cash float + Expected cash (system-calculated from cash sales, refunds, and pay-in/pay-out cash-drawer operations during the shift) + Actual cash (physically counted at close) + Difference (actual - expected, i.e. over/short). Cashier permission can be restricted to entering only Actual cash (blind count) without seeing Expected, to prevent count-to-match gaming. General industry pattern: cash drawer reconciliation = compare counted drawer total against expected-from-sales total; positive variance = overage, negative = shortage; both are logged per shift for audit/loss-prevention trending.
